newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH 1996 BANKRUPTCIES FALL NINE PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH 1996 BANKRUPTCIES FALL NINE PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The number of bankruptcies in Finland fell nine percent in 1996 on 1995 to 4,296, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Wednesday.
"The number of bankruptcies fell last year for the fourth consecutive year," SF said.
Bankruptcies declined in 1996 on 1995 in all sectors except agriculture and forestry, SF said.
The sharpest decline in bankruptcies was in service industries, where the number of companies folding fell by almost one fifth, it said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 235, e-mail news@reuters.fi
